turns.question: In what share of our customer calls on 1 and 2 October 2026 did the customer raise an objection?
turns.answer: About 33.3% (one in three) of the labelled customer calls on 1 and 2 October 2026 had the customer raise an objection (price, timing or a competitor), per the Objection rate metric, which is model-derived from gemini-3.5-flash labels under prompt v1.
